{"question":"A physical pendulum swings around an axis passing through a point P located a distance d from the center of mass. The pendulum has: 
• Mass M, 
• Moment of inertia I about the rotation axis, 
• Distance d from the center of mass to axis P. 
What is the period T of small oscillations?", "options":{"A":"T = 2π√(I / Mgd)", "B":"T = 2π√(Mgd / I)", "C":"T = 2π√(Id / Mg)", "D":"T = 2π√(d / g)"}, "correct":"A"}
